name: Tapscape

sources.title: Submit Your App — iOS/Android/Mac app review service; $99 expedited written review via PayPal, or email details to support@tapscape.com

requirements: App must be iOS, iPad, Mac, or Android — this is an app review blog, not a web SaaS directory
Guaranteed review costs $99 (expedited, 7-day turnaround, home-page featured) via PayPal or invoice
Free pitch path exists only as emailing details to support@tapscape.com — no guarantee of coverage
Paid fee does not guarantee a positive review; disclosure is added to expedited reviews
preparation: iTunes/App Store link + valid promo code for paid apps (iOS/Mac), or Google Play link (Android)
Optional: YouTube video — every review includes links to store, website, and video
PayPal account or email address for invoicing
workflow: Option A (free, no guarantee): email support@tapscape.com with app details and store link
Option B ($99): click the 'Buy Now' PayPal button on /submit-app-review/ or email for a PayPal invoice with the required details
Review is written by their staff with standardized scoring; includes social promotion to ~25K Twitter followers
Expect ~7-day turnaround for the paid expedited review
watchFor: Site banner warns of a scam email impersonating Tapscape (jannetwilson2021@gmail.com) — only trust support@tapscape.com
Payment does not buy a positive review — paid expedited reviews carry disclosure
Web/SaaS products without a mobile/desktop app are out of scope
Recent posts skew to generic sponsored tech content — editorial quality may have slipped since its 'Top 100 Gadget blog' era
countsAsLive: A review article for the app is published on tapscape.com (paid tier: home-page featured) with links to store listing and company site
unknowns: Whether free email submissions ever result in a published review
Whether links in reviews are dofollow
Whether the site still actively reviews vs. mostly runs sponsored posts
